derivation: contract C2 `hreflang_nonreciprocal`: manifest-internal B declares a return alternate with A's url and tag en (A2/A3: tag equality is ASCII case-insensitive, URLs compare after RFC 3986 normalization and are equal here); both list themselves and canonical self.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
</head><body></body></html>
files.b.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: clean-reciprocal-pair
